newsitem.title: SWEDEN: NetCom to issue two mln B series shares.
newsitem.headline: NetCom to issue two mln B series shares.

text.p: Swedish telecoms operator NetCom Systems AB said on Friday it would issue two million new B series shares to increase liquidity in the share.

"The new issue will be carried out in connection with Industriforvaltnings AB Kinneviks' sale of convertibles in NetCom Systems, converted to six million B shares," NetCom Systems said in a statement.
It said an additional 800,000 NetCom Systems B shares would be ready in case of oversubscription.
"The offer will widen the company's international share ownership and in particular increase the liquidity in NetCom shares and support the recent Nasdaq listing," NetCom said.
NetCom said it would use the proceeds from the issue for current financial needs, especially for expansion of its Danish and Norwegian operations.
